rule: A chematic gate compares against exactly one RDKit build. Where PyPI has that build for the platform, a lane that needs both engines in one process (xsmarts-autoconf) runs there with the wheel's SHA-256 checked. Where it has none, chematic's side of each gate runs on the platform without RDKit and is compared on Linux x86-64 with the pinned Linux wheel; lanes that need one process are not run there and are listed as not applicable, never replaced by another RDKit version.

linux-x86_64.note: chematic's Linux wheels are CPython 3.9 builds and this RDKit has no CPython 3.9 wheel: the two-stage gates run the cp39 wheel without RDKit, and xsmarts-autoconf builds the published sdist for CPython 3.12.

macos-x86_64.note: PyPI has no RDKit 2026.3.6 macOS x86-64 wheel (checked 2026-10-08): the two-stage gates run, xsmarts-autoconf is not applicable.
